details:
Please make a button that allows users to freeze their avatars whole body in place at our desired position including arms/hands. Current afk poses are limiting and dont always match the situation you are in while requireing gogo on the avatar to use. This would not only help stop body disforming while afk but also allow you to leave your body in a position that best fits the situation. Showcasing that your afk isnt always desireable as sometimes its for something small and you dont want change the mood just because you had to go get something. This freeze feature already exisits for fbt trackers disconnect but is only designed to stop limbs from flying when tracking is lost. Even if you wanted to use this method for other means its very difficult as you would need to one by one turn each tracker off hopeing you didnt move while trying to reach for the trackers so you dont look wonky in game. 

Example #1 - Sitting around a group of friends and your mom calls for you, you turn on the freeze and take care of what you need to do and come back in the same position you were last in.

Example #2 - You are cuddling/laying down watching movies and you have to pee but dont want to un-cuddle the person. You use the freeze button leaving your body where you had it and come right back as if you never left.

Example #3 - You want to sleep on vrc but want to remove your trackers to feel more comfortable but not lose the position. You use the button and wallah your good to go.

There are endless useage for this type of feature including being able to afk/freeze in funny uniqe positions or set a pose to take a photo so you stay locked in place while not dying trying to hold still especially if your arms are in the air.
title: Avatar Position Freezing.
